name: cmogpt
tagline: AI-powered business diagnosis and strategy for Shopify brands.
description: ecommerce performance intelligence for DTC brands.

tools.name: about_my_store
tools.title: My Store Context
tools.description: Returns store profile including category, growth stage, and last Shopify order date. Used to establish session context before any analysis.

tools.name: about_my_account
tools.title: My Account Summary
tools.description: Returns CMOgpt account details including job_id required for all metric calls, current plan, and connected platforms.

tools.name: get_diagnosis
tools.title: Business Diagnosis
tools.description: Returns a pre-scored, ranked causal decision tree for a given metric over a specified period and depth. Used to identify root causes of metric movements.

tools.name: get_marketing_budget
tools.title: Marketing Budget
tools.description: Returns the current daily marketing budget configured for the store, including total daily spend amount and last-updated date. No additional parameters required.

tools.name: get_metrics_manifest
tools.title: Metrics Manifest
tools.description: Lists all available metrics in a specified domain (SALES, PROFITABILITY, REPEAT-BUSINESS, MARKETING, LTV).

tools.name: get_metric_detail
tools.title: Metric Detail
tools.description: Returns detailed data for a specific metric including current value, benchmark comparison, and status.

tools.name: get_metric_history
tools.title: Metric History
tools.description: Returns historical daily data points for a metric over a specified lookback period (up to 90 days).

tools.name: get_my_targets
tools.title: My Targets
tools.description: Returns the metric targets set by the founder for their business.

tools.name: get_benchmarks
tools.title: Industry Benchmarks
tools.description: Returns industry benchmark ranges for all applicable metrics, matched to the store's product category. No additional parameters required. Benchmark values are the reference point for gap scoring in get_diagnosis.

tools.name: get_business_domain
tools.title: Business Domains
tools.description: Lists valid business domains (SALES, PROFITABILITY, REPEAT-BUSINESS, MARKETING, LTV) for use as the metrics_domain parameter in get_metrics_manifest.

tools.name: get_cohort_analysis
tools.title: Cohort Analysis
tools.description: Returns weekly acquisition-cohort profitability over a span — a blended summary plus per-cohort rows tracking CAC, break-even, repeat rate, and contribution margin by days-since-first-order. Not available via get_metric_history.

tools.name: get_customer_profitability
tools.title: Customer Profitability
tools.description: Returns one customer's profitability metrics — margins, CAC, and break-even status — supported by their full order history.

tools.name: get_ltv_distribution
tools.title: LTV Distribution
tools.description: Returns customer LTV statistics by deciles and quartiles across the portfolio.

tools.name: get_ltv_segments
tools.title: LTV Segments
tools.description: Returns the latest customer LTV recency segmentation statistics (Active, Lapsed, Dormant, Churned) — counts, sales, and profitability margins per segment, including reactivation of Active customers from other segments.

tools.name: get_trading_week
tools.title: Trading Week
tools.description: Returns the list of COHORT-WEEK values and their FIRST-ORDER-DATE (Sunday-to-Saturday trading weeks), used to resolve cohort_date for get_cohort_analysis.

tools.name: list_ltv_customers
tools.title: LTV Customer List
tools.description: Returns a filtered, ranked list of customers by segment, LTV decile, and break-even status — used for whale-finding and win-back targeting. Limited to 200 results.

tools.name: list_recent_orders
tools.title: Recent Orders
tools.description: Returns up to 200 most recent Shopify orders enriched with CMOgpt contribution margin data. Used for data verification and onboarding.

tools.name: get_marketing_channels
tools.title: Marketing Channels
tools.description: Returns the store's active marketing channels and their platform_code values (e.g. Meta, Google, TikTok). Used to resolve platform_code before writing a marketing spend change.

tools.name: upsert_marketing_spend
tools.title: Update Marketing Spend
tools.description: Writes a new daily marketing spend amount for a channel over a date range. Mutates live budget data — only called after the founder explicitly confirms platform_code, from_date, to_date, and marketing_spend.

tools.name: upsert_target
tools.title: Update Target
tools.description: Writes a new founder-set target value for a metric. Mutates live target data — only called after the founder explicitly confirms target_name and target_value.

tools.name: ui_render_test
tools.title: UI Render Test
tools.description: Dummy diagnostic tool that returns a ui:// resource to verify MCP Apps rendering works in the host. Used only by the ui-visualization-test skill.

useCases: Weekly business health check — revenue, margin, MER, discount rate, and repeat ratio read as a system with a single verdict and priority action (cmo-health-check).
Targeted metric diagnosis — root-cause drill-down into any underperforming metric using a pre-scored causal decision tree (cmo-diagnose-metrics).

Contribution margin diagnosis — identify whether margin pressure is driven by discounting, COGS, shipping subsidy, or marketing cost, split by new vs repeat customers (cmo-diagnose-contribution-margin).
Growth quality diagnosis — evaluate whether revenue growth is compounding value or buying revenue at the expense of margin and retention; answers 'should I spend more on ads' (cmo-build-profit).

Marketing spend review — weekly recommendation to increase, hold, reduce, or cut spend based on MER trend and contribution margin, with a specific dollar amount, and can write the change to the connected channel once the founder confirms (cmo-optimize-marketing-budget).

Marketing budget setting — five-step MER method to calculate a data-grounded monthly and daily marketing budget, and can save the resulting daily spend and MER target once the founder confirms (cmo-set-marketing-budget).
Order verification — show recent Shopify orders enriched with contribution margin data to verify live data connection (cmo-list-recent-orders).
Cohort analysis — track acquisition-week cohorts of customers over time to see whether newer cohorts are more or less profitable, and how fast they reach break-even (cmo-analyze-cohort).

Customer profitability concepts — explains the RFM recency segmentation (Active/Lapsed/Dormant/Churned), LTV deciles/quartiles, and break-even/timing rules that anchor all profitability analysis (cmo-analyze-customer-profitability).
Customer LTV and payback — contribution LTV:CAC, payback days, and P1-P5 purchase-journey reasoning; the playbook for raising customer profitability, built on the concepts above (cmo-analyze-ltv).
Single customer inspection — full order history, CAC, margins, and break-even for one customer so the founder can trust the LTV/CAC numbers behind it (cmo-inspect-customer).

Marketing spend and target updates — can write a founder-confirmed marketing spend override or a business metric target once the founder explicitly confirms the values (cmo-update-marketing-spend-business-target).
capabilities.dataHandling: CMOgpt reads Shopify order, customer, and sales data via a secure server-to-server integration. Data is stored in CMOgpt's infrastructure. This connector reads store data by default; it can also write a founder-confirmed marketing spend or target change back to CMOgpt, but only after the founder explicitly authorizes that specific change — no write is ever issued silently. No conversation data is collected or stored. Data is not shared with third parties other than Shopify (source) and Anthropic (Claude processing). Retention follows CMOgpt's privacy policy at https://cmogpt.io/privacy.
